pages.text: The Energy Generator is the entry-level standalone generator: Akaishi fuel is burned to produce a base output of $(bold)75 AE/tick$(reset) (AE = Akaishi Energy).$(br2)$(bold)Upgrades:$(reset) it has 10 upgrade slots. Each Energy Production Upgrade Component multiplies output by ×1.75 with a 1% output tax, up to approximately ×242 when fully fitted.$(br2)$(bold)Five fuel tiers$(reset) (heating value):$(li)Akaishi Crystal: 2000$(li)Raw Akaishi Block: 20000$(li)Akaishi Essence: 80000$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence: 800000$(li)Condensed Akaishi Essence Block: 7200000$(br2)Fuel sources and refining are covered in $(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l). For higher output, see the $(l:akaishi:gen_matrix)Akaishi Generator Matrix$(/l).

$(bold)Retired builds:$(reset) the Small Assembly (3×3×3) and Super Generator (5×5×5) block-built forms have been retired. The Akaishi Generator Matrix now performs that role, and the old blocks are usable only as spare parts.$(br2)$(bold)Standalone vs matrix:$(reset) the generator is inexpensive, requires no structure and has its own fuel slot; the matrix requires grid power but starts at a ×45 multiplier. The choice depends on budget and line size.$(br2)Forming requirements and the stats of both tiers are in the $(l:akaishi:gen_matrix)Akaishi Generator Matrix$(/l) entry.

Reading order: $(l:akaishi:energy_basics)Akaishi Energy Basics$(/l) for fuels, then connect $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cells$(/l). To scale up, build the $(l:akaishi:gen_matrix)Generator Matrix$(/l); when that is insufficient, use the $(l:akaishi:reactor)Reactor$(/l).
